title: The Ploopy A+ Trackball Is Here
summary: Ploopy announces the A+ Trackball, their latest open-source hardware trackball peripheral designed for ergonomic computing and customization enthusiasts.
problem_solved: Provides an open-source, highly customizable trackball option for users seeking ergonomic mouse alternatives
why_valuable: Ploopy's commitment to open-source hardware allows users to modify, repair, and customize their peripherals, promoting sustainability and user control
